Billing Collaboration

Your Practice. Your Billing Company. One Platform.

PMEX is not sold on the condition that you switch your billing to PMEX. The platform is built to be your practice's central system regardless of who actually handles billing, whether that's PMEX, your existing vendor, an internal team, or several vendors managing different locations at once.

That independence is intentional. A practice shouldn't have to choose between keeping a billing relationship it trusts and getting modern visibility into its own revenue cycle.
